scope: Historical visible UI plus source inspection, APK identity matched; runtime gaps explicitly preserved

areas.surface: App header: Export metadata, Toggle Theme, Settings
areas.behavior: Open export picker; change temporary light/dark theme; open AI settings. Icons use these accessibility names.

areas.surface: Left-edge Open menu / Close menu; Home, Folders, Sources, Queue, Videos, Images
areas.route: Tap the handle on the left edge; app initially opens with menu expanded
areas.behavior: Navigate to each destination; close menu without navigation.

areas.surface: Menu Summary
areas.behavior: Read Total Videos Scanned, Filtered Backlog items and LLM Provider. Source counts can include unavailable historical entries.

areas.surface: Home: Overview, Expand / Collapse
areas.behavior: Expand counts New, Queued, Proc., Review; read LLM/model/host status, media access and Videos Found. Counts are informational.

areas.surface: Home: Guide, Expand guide / Collapse guide
areas.behavior: Read private OCR and workflow guide text; collapse. Computer-export wording does not establish a reachable transfer feature.

areas.surface: Home: Scan Videos; Sources: Refresh inventory
areas.route: Home toolbar or Sources inventory header
areas.behavior: Request photo/video access; scan storage; see scan progress; retry. Scan disabled while in progress.

areas.surface: Home limited-access banner: Change / Dismiss; Android access choices
areas.route: Home when selected-media access is granted
areas.behavior: Change selected photos/videos; dismiss banner; grant, deny or revoke access in emulator Android settings. Android prompt labels remain unobserved.

areas.surface: Home: Start Batch, Process Next, Pause Batch
areas.behavior: Start eligible Keep media; process next; pause ongoing work; see no-eligible-work message.

areas.surface: Live Batch panel: progress, Pause / Resume
areas.route: Any destination while batch is active or paused
areas.behavior: Read batch state, current step and progress; pause/resume. Source-only conditional panel, not observed during this run.

areas.surface: Sources: Phone media inventory; access and count/size totals
areas.behavior: Read available total, Unreviewed, Keep, Selected to remove; pending, unavailable and trashed items excluded. Open Rules, Tags, Bin.

areas.surface: Sources: category cards and Open [category]
areas.behavior: Open Camera, Screenshots, Screen recordings, Downloads, WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business, Messenger, DJI, Facebook, Skype, Zalo, Twitter, Other or folder-derived category when indexed.

areas.surface: Source category: Show all sources, Refresh inventory, filename/size/evidence
areas.behavior: Return to category list; refresh; read all rows and source evidence. Media rows do not open Preview.

areas.surface: Source subcategory chips, horizontally scrollable
areas.route: Sources → Screenshots with inferred Facebook/Instagram filenames
areas.behavior: Read counts/bytes and Inferred from filename. Chip taps have no action in source; runtime no-op unverified.

areas.surface: Source review dropdown: New, Keep, Later, Remove
areas.route: Sources → category → current decision beside file
areas.behavior: Change review choice; dismiss outside/Back. Review choice is separate from Queue processing status and Bin placement.

areas.surface: Folders: Target Watch Folders, Active, Add watch folder, Remove
areas.behavior: Register tree folder using Android picker; cancel; remove registration. Source currently does not use registrations to restrict scanner.

areas.surface: Android folder picker: storage root, folder list, USE THIS FOLDER, privacy block
areas.behavior: Navigate a test folder; use/cancel; root says Can’t use this folder. Picker also has List view, New folder, Sort by..., More options, CREATE NEW FOLDER.

areas.surface: Folders sidebar: Search folders..., Clear search, folder checkboxes, Add selected to queue
areas.behavior: Find URI-derived folder groups; select/unselect; toggle queue state for kept files in selected groups.

areas.surface: Folders: Auto add switch; Detection Channels, Record, Shots
areas.route: Folders → Auto add; channels appear only while enabled
areas.behavior: Persist switches; observe new media. Source observer rescans; channel settings do not filter and no automatic Keep/analysis occurs.

areas.surface: Queue sort: Name, Status, Size
areas.behavior: Sort visible backlog alphabetically, by state, or ascending size.

areas.surface: Queue selection: row checkbox, select-all, Process selected, Archive selected, Cancel
areas.route: Queue → select row or header checkbox
areas.behavior: Select/deselect; process selected kept files; archive selected; cancel selection. Selection toolbar conditional.

areas.surface: Queue rows: Location, File, Size, Status, Actions, empty backlog
areas.behavior: Read table/status badges and filenames; empty message directs scan. Active filter dropdown is absent.

areas.surface: Queue Rename (automatic suggested name)
areas.behavior: Generate filename from OCR or existing name; Android write approval may be needed. No manual filename form is reachable.

areas.surface: Queue Folder
areas.behavior: Read Location toast containing item URI; no folder browser opens.

areas.surface: Queue Output (completed items only)
areas.route: Queue → output icon beside processed item
areas.behavior: Read saved result window; disabled for new/error/archived states.

areas.surface: Queue Preview and Process
areas.route: Queue → eye icon or circular-arrow icon
areas.behavior: Open metadata/editor; Process enabled only for Keep. Preview’s process still enforces Keep underneath.

areas.surface: Videos archive: table, row/header checkbox, Restore selected, Delete selected index entries
areas.behavior: Select archived videos, restore to Queue, remove only local index entries. Physical file deletion is a separate workflow.

areas.surface: Images archive: same controls; Name, Status, Size
areas.behavior: Same actions for archived images. Source sort ignores chosen option and selections can span both archive destinations.

areas.surface: Preview window: Minimize, Full Window / Standard Window, Close, Restore preview, Back
areas.route: Queue → Preview; minimized badge at bottom right
areas.behavior: Resize; scroll; minimize/restore; close. Overlay Android Back behavior unverified.

areas.surface: Preview metadata, Processing Error, Copy Error
areas.behavior: Read name/URI/Mime/Bytes/Status/Completed step; copy actual processing error when present.

areas.surface: Preview horizontal action strip: Process media, Reset model data, Archive media
areas.route: Preview → action strip; scroll horizontally if clipped
areas.behavior: Process eligible file; erase only disposable saved model data/notes/OCR; archive. Reset has no confirmation.

areas.surface: Preview Mark Trash Candidate / Unmark Trash Candidate
areas.behavior: Toggle legacy ready-to-delete status; does not add Bin entry or delete file.

areas.surface: Preview Manual Transcript & Annotations; Group 1/2/3; Line 1/2; Action Roadmap / Notes Markdown Map; Save edits
areas.behavior: Edit notes, category path, headlines and roadmap; save or discard. Values may exist before processing.

areas.surface: Preview Scene Text Evidence Timeline (OCR), timestamps and empty guidance
areas.behavior: Read extracted evidence; empty guidance suggests processing. No video player/seek/pause is present.

areas.surface: Preview Extracted Links and Extracted Tech / Command Snippets
areas.route: Preview when corresponding saved lists are nonempty
areas.behavior: Read links and command snippets; links are plain text, with no opening/copy handler in current source. Conditional content not reached in emulator.

areas.surface: Preview Remove index entry
areas.behavior: Remove app metadata/index row without deleting physical file; rescan may rediscover. No confirmation.

areas.surface: Preview System Real Media Cleanup Action: Move media to trash, Delete media forever
areas.behavior: Request Android trash/permanent-delete approval; cancel or approve only on isolated disposable media.

areas.surface: Android media-write/trash/delete approvals and cancellation
areas.route: Rename or cleanup of externally owned media; Bin Delete all
areas.behavior: Approve/deny/cancel; unavailable-version and opening/verification failures have different messages. Prompt buttons not inspected.

areas.surface: Output: A.I. Structured Content Map, Category path, Summary headline 1/2, Action plan Roadmap / Commands, Done
areas.behavior: Read saved structured result; resize/minimize/restore/Close; Done closes. Fallback wording identifies local output.

areas.surface: Settings window: Ollama Advanced Connection Settings, AI setup
areas.behavior: Resize/minimize/restore/close; Save settings commits; close discards drafts.

areas.surface: Settings provider menu: PC, Cloud, Gemini, Device
areas.behavior: Switch provider draft; dismiss; provider-specific fields appear. Existing cached models may be stale after switch.

areas.surface: Settings Host, Test connection, Unknown / Connected / Unreachable
areas.behavior: Enter endpoint; test; read result. Connection display can describe a previous check, not current analysis success.

areas.surface: Settings Model, Sync models tag list, No model
areas.behavior: Fetch/select models; dismiss dropdown; read empty state. Failed or empty sync can retain cached list.

areas.surface: Settings Timeout, 5–300 seconds
areas.behavior: Enter seconds; invalid styling does not block Save; source clamps numeric range or uses 30 for nonnumeric input.

areas.surface: Settings Temp slider, Prompt, Reset prompt
areas.behavior: Set 0–1 temperature; edit/reset system prompt; save or cancel.

areas.surface: Settings API key (masked)
areas.behavior: Enter supplied disposable test key; verify masking and recovery from missing/invalid credentials. Do not inspect saved secrets.

areas.surface: Settings Device disclaimer
areas.behavior: Read Keyword fallback runs on this device. No on-device language model is installed.; process without network.

areas.surface: Rules list: Back, Add copy rule, Add obscured rule; No rules
areas.behavior: Open create dialogs or return; inspect inline messages.

areas.surface: Rules card: enabled switch, Preview, Run, Edit, Delete
areas.behavior: Disable/enable; dry preview; apply rule; revise/delete definition. Run disabled while off. Effects are not automatically undone on rule deletion.

areas.surface: Add rule / Edit dialog: Name, Score, 0–1, Save, Cancel
areas.route: Rules → Add copy rule/Add obscured rule/Edit
areas.behavior: Create or revise; validate name and score; Cancel/outside/Back discard. Score only for Obscure.

areas.surface: Tags: Back, Tag field, Add, tag cards/counts, Edit, Delete
areas.behavior: Create/select/deselect/rename/delete tag; blank Add disabled. Empty Tags has no dedicated message.

areas.surface: Tags Media: Tagged / Show all, Add tag / Remove tag
areas.route: Tags → tap a tag card; scroll below tags
areas.behavior: Filter assignments; assign/unassign currently available media; watch counts.

areas.surface: Tag Edit dialog: Tag, Save, Cancel
areas.behavior: Rename; blank disabled; duplicate/oversize ignored by source without message; cancel.

areas.surface: Bin: Back, Delete all, count/bytes, thumbnail cards, Recover, Bin empty
areas.behavior: Read entries; recover previous review choice; request permanent deletion of all eligible entries. No separate Undo button.

areas.surface: Android export document picker: filename media-metadata.json, SAVE, folder/navigation controls
areas.behavior: Pick writable destination and filename; cancel; handle duplicate filename and write failure. Downloads picker observed. Folder creation/sort/view/more-options delegated to Android.

areas.surface: Unreachable legacy UI declarations
areas.route: No visible route established; listed here to avoid silently omitting them
areas.behavior: Legacy Configure Ollama Local LLM, Enable, Presets, I agree; alternate target folder controls/card; FilterDropdown; sidebar AI settings; transferToComputer. Do not prescribe fake access routes.

areas.surface: Packaged debug-only activities and framework screens
areas.route: APK manifest only; absent from ordinary navigation
areas.behavior: InventoryRecreationTestActivity, UxEvidenceActivity, MediaDeleteEvidenceActivity, Compose PreviewActivity and ComponentActivity are not launched; test activities can mutate fixtures.

current_overrides.folder_scope: All scans restricted to chosen folders plus child folders; none chosen means all allowed media
current_overrides.drafts: Non-secret Settings fields and Preview edits survive minimize; key draft stays in memory only
